Area a 30-foot line you can see

Duration 1 minute

Saving Throw Reflex

Declare the line and hold it. Any creature attempting to cross it must attempt a Reflex save against your class DC; on a failure its movement stops and it takes damage equal to two of your weapon's damage dice, and on a critical failure it is also knocked prone on its own side. Enemies that have seen this happen to someone else take a −2 circumstance penalty to that save. This does not cost you reactions or ammunition.
